evidence: The phase content and crystalline properties of the films, including their orientation in relation to the substrate have been examined with a Siemens D5000 X-ray diffractometer using CuKα radiation and usual X-ray diffraction (XRD) y22y-, o-, and j-scan methods. All the patterns correspond to the tetragonal (cassiterite) phase of SnO2 and show a preferential (101) orientation.
